document: DS14927 Rev 2 - Table 62. IWDG min/max timeout period at 32 kHz (LSI).
title: Table 62. IWDG min/max timeout period at 32 kHz (LSI).
text_helper: Table 62. IWDG min/max timeout period at 32 kHz (LSI). — section 5.3.21 Timer characteristics. Prescaler divider, PR[2:0] bits, Min timeout RL[11:0] = 0x000, Max timeout RL[11:0] = 0xFFF, Unit.

notes: 1. The minimum SDA data setup time during open-drain-mode is 3 ns, as specified in the MIPI Alliance specification for I3C. DS14927 - Rev 2 page 92/133
legend: Note: For the values in this table, the exact timings still depend on the phasing of the APB interface clock versus the LSI clock, so that there is
always a full RC period of uncertainty.
